skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develops skills in application programming, including understanding and applying object-oriented programming concepts, working with Windows Forms, and integrating with databases.
Understands and applies object-oriented programming principles in C#.
Integrates applications with databases using ADO.NET and SQL Server.
Solves problems by applying programming concepts and techniques to real-world scenarios.
Collaborates effectively in teams to complete projects and solve problems.
Demonstrates the ability to learn independently and seek out resources to enhance understanding.
Manages projects, including planning, execution, and delivery of results.
Analyzes and evaluates problems, and develops solutions using critical thinking skills.
Communicates effectively, both verbally and in writing, to present solutions and ideas.
Proficiency in developing applications using Windows Forms.
Proficiency in SQL for database management.
Proficiency in using ADO.NET for database integration.
Proficiency in XML data handling and processing.
Ability to generate reports using Crystal Reports.
